استفتيت (form X)
# اِسْتَفْتَيْتُ (istaftaytu) /is.taf.taj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
# اِسْتَفْتَيْتَ (istaftayta) /is.taf.taj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
# اِسْتَفْتَيْتِ (istaftayti) /is.taf.taj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
# اُسْتُفْتِيتُ (ustuftītu) /us.tuf.tiː.tu/:
